text:
Priya: hey team — quick heads up, i'm stuck at the airport, flight diverted. i'm the primary for tonight (00:00-08:00 PST) and can't reliably take pages for the next ~6 hours. sorry for the short notice.

Priya: primary/secondary tonight were me + @Connor. Connor, are you able to stretch into primary until ~08:00 PST? i can do async handoff if needed.

incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager routed to Priya (primary) — ALERT: inference-prod-east latency > 750ms (5m avg). paging urgency: high.

Connor: @Priya not great for me — i'm mid-meeting, and EU morning starts in 2h. i can be secondary but can't be primary for the whole window.

Janelle: i can cover primary for ~00:30-07:30 PST (i'm awake, on-call coverage window matches). happy to take it if you want me to.

Priya: Janelle — absolute life-saver if you can. i'll transfer context and post quick runbook notes here.

Priya: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-latency
Priya: short play: 1) check model queue sizes (k8s pod autoscaler), 2) tail inference logs for 5xx, 3) re-route to fallback model variant if spike continues (>10m).

runbook-bot: Runbook summary attached — Steps: 
```
# quick checks
kubectl -n inference get hpa
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=inference -c runtime --tail=200 | grep ERROR
rdwctl route set inference-prod-east --variant small-quant --reason "emergency fallback"
```

Connor: if you take primary Janelle, i'll be secondary and can push the fallback if needed. Priya, please update PagerDuty handoff when you're settled.

Priya: done — i updated the PD note: "Priya diverted, Janelle primary 00:30-07:30 PST, Connor secondary. See runbook link."

Janelle: taking the bridge now. i'll open a quick zoom if we need live debug. can someone post the current customer impact?

Connor: current impact: elevated p95 latency for text-generation routes to inference-prod-east, ~8% increased error budget burn for the last 10m, a few user-facing timeouts reported in chat feature. no major page storms yet.

Janelle: on it. i'll check queue and tail logs. if i can't stabilise in 15m i'll flip to small-quant fallback and post update here.

Priya: thank you both. really appreciate the quick cover. i don't expect to be reachable but i'll check messages. :pray:

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Acknowledgement recorded — Janelle acknowledged the Pager.

Janelle: quick note — auth-service 502s spiked alongside inference errors, looks like one of the edge proxies dropped requests. rolling logs now.

Janelle: rolling fallback to small-quant variant now: `rdwctl route set inference-prod-east --variant small-quant --reason "auto-fallback during spike"`

Connor: watching metrics. if fallback reduces p95 by >200ms we keep it for 30m and create a follow-up ticket to tune batching parameters.

Janelle: p95 dropped ~300ms after fallback. errors down to baseline. i'm keeping primary until 07:30 PST as agreed. will create a post-incident note for config changes.

Priya: excellent. when you're done please add the timeline to the PD incident and ping SRE-ops for a quick postmortem tomorrow.

Janelle: will do. also added a short runbook tweak: check iptable limits on edge-proxy when auth 502s coincide with inference spikes.

Connor: noted. i'll follow up on batching knobs in optimize and propose safe defaults.

Priya: again, huge thanks. i'll log formal handoff into the oncall calendar and update my availability. :heart:

Janelle: np — marking thread as resolved for now but keeping notifications on until 07:30 PST.

incident-bot: Incident resolved: inference-prod-east latency returned to normal. Auto-close in 30m unless a new alert triggers.

Priya: filing a short retrospective doc — link will be posted here later.

Connor: thanks all.
